description: `--timeout 30` on `cli run submit` suggests `--wait 30s`: the unit a bare number lacks is added.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown option.
Detail: unknown option --timeout for `cli run submit`; did you mean --wait? --wait takes a duration with a unit, so 30 is 30s
Action: Use --wait 30s: `prose cli run submit hello.prose.md --wait 30s`.
